## [1.1.0](https://github.com/TahmidSummy/proxy-patches/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0) (2026-11-04)

### 🔒 Leak fixes
* **No more direct connections when the proxy fails.** Android's built-in `HttpURLConnection` quietly fell back to a direct connection whenever the proxy failed: when none was set, it was down, or it rejected the login. That let SDKs such as AppsFlyer and Firebase logging connect without the proxy. Every connection now goes through the proxy, or doesn't happen at all.

### ✨ New features
* **Change your proxy any time, without repatching.** Long-press the Reddit icon → **Proxy settings** to set the host, port, HTTPS/TLS, username and password. Your proxy is no longer baked into the APK at patch time. Changes apply to new connections straight away.
  * **Test connection** checks your proxy and tells you what's wrong if it doesn't work.
  * The patch options in Morphe Manager are now optional starting values.
* **Run without proxy switch.** Turn the proxy off and on from the same screen. Switch **Run without proxy** on and the app connects directly. Leave it off (the default) and everything goes through your proxy, and the app stays offline if the proxy isn't working.

([1b9e5da](https://github.com/TahmidSummy/proxy-patches/commit/1b9e5daba30bc27d1fbd7350fadc595475f8f5d0))
